tldr: Aries rising: direct, energetic, and quick to meet life head-first.
body: With Aries rising, the first move is action. You tend to meet the world directly, respond quickly, and learn by entering the situation rather than waiting until every variable is settled.
approach: Initiates fast, leads with instinct, and prefers momentum over prolonged deliberation.
shadow: Impatience, brusqueness, combativeness, or treating every first encounter like something to push through.
note: Authored from approved project Big Three and sign material.
